text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The light feels like... it's about to pour 
down—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beside me, Believe murmurs softly beneath 
a sky pouring with stars.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A rest day. Tonight, along with Dantsu 
Flame and the others, we came for a night 
hike up to the nearby mountain summit.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The stars were truly gorgeous...! Getting 
to come all the way out here together with 
everyone was so much fun too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Totally~. I was thinking, "Isn't a night 
hike kind of a high bar?" but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was so surprised! Believe-chan was 
giving such spot-on directions and leading 
the way super well~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Mountain climbing is your hobby, right? If 
I recall correctly, you're also part of a 
local climbing club, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, every single one of us got 
to have such a wonderful experience.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No. ...Or rather, I think it's too early 
for you to be thanking me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let us head down the mountain soon. While 
the moon is still bright.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
This mountain isn't particularly high or 
rugged, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...The paths are strangely intricate, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I thought I was simply retracing 
the path we took to descend the mountain, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... H-Huh~? Didn't we pass by 
this river just a moment ago...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you feel that way too, Senpai...!? I 
was wondering if it was just my 
imagination, but...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No, it looks familiar to me too...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's weird... If I remember right, as we 
were climbing, there were route markers 
made of fluorescent tape wrapped around 
trees all over the place, weren't there?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen it for the longest time. 
It'd be nice if I just happened to 
overlook it, but...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Believe-san! How's it lookin'? You 
said you were checking the direction—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: The compass is going haywire.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It was totally fine on the way up, but 
now it just keeps spinning and the needle 
won't stop."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I walked around a bit trying to check our 
position by the moon or stars, but the 
foliage is so thick everywhere that I 
can't see the sky at all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
N-Now that you mention it, feels like 
we've been wandering through this deep 
forest forever...!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Umm, okay, so how about we all walk 
together to a more open area... Wait, no, 
if we could do that, we wouldn't be in 
this mess right now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As their guardian, a chill ran down my 
spine. I assumed it would be fine since 
they climbed up so easily, but... this 
situation is totally—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
S-S-S-Stranded~~~?! This is bad, bad, I 
gotta contact someone—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Wait! Out of service?! Why?! It was 
working totally fine on the way here~!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't this just getting lost?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Believe-chan, what... what do you 
mean by that~...?!
*Splat.*

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
......Um. Everyone... did you hear that? 
Just now... was that like... footsteps—
*Splat.*
*Splat.*
*Splat.*

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eep... Hieee... I-It's getting closer... 
It's coming right for us... !?
*Splat.*
*Splat.*
*S p l a t.*

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaaaa~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Dants's Smartphone
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz!!*)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaaaa~~~~~!?!?
choice_data_list:
Wait, no, wasn't that the sound of a 
phone!?
Wait, no, isn't that a phone ringing!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't this Dantsu-san's smartphone?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh... A-A call?! But there wasn't any 
signal... Wait, whatever, for now...!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hello!? Um— Huh, Cafe...!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...The call finally went through, didn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Cafe-chan...! Um, well, right now――!!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"‘Are you... alr—...? ...Over he—... 
...-tsu-san...--’"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, Cafe-chan?! Hello?! Hellooo...?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...rry. Not much, time left— Only 
telling... what's... necessary."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Please talk about... what makes you 
feel――supremely happy."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? T-Talk with each other? About 
things that... make us happy...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Yes. That is... the only— that can be—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah!? Hello, Cafe-chan!? Helloooo...!?！？

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
W-We just gotta do it, don't we!? 
...Right!? You know, talk to get everyone 
hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
R-Right?! Cafe-chan's advice at times like 
this is something you should definitely 
listen to, right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Umm~ umm~ a happy mood... Happy...! And it 
says 'talk with each other', so...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, D-Dantsu-chan!! That UmaTube video we 
watched while packing in the room... I-it 
was hilarious, wasn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Ah, that's right!! Umm............

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ……That was so much fun, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right~~~~!! ...Oh crap, I can't hold out 
any longer!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san, you too! Don't you have 
anything!? Anything, anything at all, 
hurry up~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, despite trembling with fear, each 
of them somehow managed to share 
"heartwarming stories" with one another, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given the situation, there was no way we 
could keep the conversation going forever. 
Just as I was gradually getting backed 
into a corner—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...! U-Um... and then—and 
theeeen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having been deep in thought for so long— 
or perhaps carefully choosing her words— 
Believe finally spoke up quietly."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Lala-san's and my room.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
It's always so clean. ...It really helps a 
lot.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh???

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel calmer when things are neat and 
tidy. It helps clear my head, too."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: However, the dorms are double rooms.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I have my domain. And the opponent has 
theirs. ...That is how it should be.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
But Ms. Lara... always makes sure to keep 
her own area completely spotless, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...That's why—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. ...To have someone like you as 
my roommate.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! No way! I... I totally thought—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, I-I'm so happy~~~...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Swoosh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: O-Oh my? The atmosphere around here just—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...!! Thank goodness—I found you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: C-Cafe-chan!? Um, wait, are we...!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm... okay now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The thing tempting you all... has 
departed. Because you showed that you were 
not enticed by it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Good work. Just as I told you—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I am so... so glad to see that it brought 
you such joy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head down the mountain?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Let us do that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after making it safely down the 
mountain—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the curtain fell on that bizarre 
night.
choice_data_list:
I'm glad you and your roommate get along 
so well.

Th-That was quite an experience, wasn't 
it...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Close friends... I wonder? I don't think 
it's quite the same kind of relationship 
as Dantsu-san and Mirako-san, though—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Just that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'll go shopping for cleaning supplies 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...With Lala-san. That's what we were 
just talking about, so..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Ah, your expression...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Shall I draw a picture of a Baku for 
you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please place it under your pillow. It 
will eat your bad dreams.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...It's a good-luck charm. My grandma 
taught it to me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The picture of the baku that Believe 
drew with such care was simple yet warm, 
and that night, I slept even better than 
usual."
